term: whole power of being and restricted participation in SCG I.28
definition: In this source reasoning, what is its own being has being according to its whole power, without lacking excellence or admitting defect. The particular imperfect participation of things that merely exist is contrasted with absolute being, whose imperfection is denied.
note: Chapter[1] contrasts mere existence with living and defines universal perfection by absence of lacking excellence; [2] uses whiteness and its receiver as an analogy. This source sense is not bare equality of represented principle-map values, a universal all-other-beings participation rule or an independently defended exhaustive reception theory. [4] does not quantify over every x distinct from God. The existing degree/approach and StrictPrimacy interfaces remain separate: measure-role and graduated approach do not supply the identity-sensitive no-tie formula. Generalizing this account to any competing actual necessary root, formal/eminent perfection and the ontology/degree dictionary remain OPEN. Primitive distinct whole natures are not excluded merely by this gloss. Source fidelity is distinct from metaphysical truth; no new relation is imposed on existing models.
